TAKE THE TEST. READ IT AT HOME.

At-home tests.

Eight self-tests with different sample types. Choose a product to see what it checks and how to use it.

SHIFT HEALTH · Self-test

Bowel Health

A home FIT self-test that checks a small stool sample for blood you may not be able to see.

Preparing for SHIFTExplore test

SHIFT HEALTH · Self-test

Prostate Health

A finger-prick PSA self-test, completed and read at home in around five minutes.

Preparing for SHIFTExplore test

SHIFT HEALTH · Self-test

Male Fertility

A semen self-test that checks sperm concentration as one indicator of male fertility.

Preparing for SHIFTExplore test

SHIFT HEALTH · Self-test

Cholesterol

A finger-prick self-test that shows the band your total cholesterol falls into, using a colour guide.

Preparing for SHIFTExplore test

SHIFT HEALTH · Self-test

Vitamin D

A finger-prick vitamin D self-test, with a result read at home using the supplied guide.

Preparing for SHIFTExplore test

SHIFT HEALTH · Self-test

Iron Deficiency

A ferritin self-test using a finger-prick sample. Ferritin is a protein associated with stored iron.

Preparing for SHIFTExplore test

SHIFT HEALTH · Self-test

Thyroid

A finger-prick self-test for TSH, used as an indicator of a possible underactive thyroid.

SHIFT HEALTH · Self-test

Kidney Health

A urine self-test that checks for increased albumin, a marker that may need further assessment.

A test is not a complete assessment of your health. Ask a healthcare professional about persistent symptoms or a result that concerns you. You do not need to buy a test or a supplement to use My Timber.
